thread:
incident-bot: PAGER sev2 — multi-GPU collective livelock detected on cluster-prod, job=job-9a3f, model=gpt-embed-v2, affected pods: gpu-node-45/gpt-embed-0, gpu-node-46/gpt-embed-1. NCCL timeouts observed. Auto-evict attempted.
maya: Oncall here — seeing elevated tail latency and some containers restarting. Pulling logs.
tj: nvlink errors and cuda Xid 79 on gpu-node-45, GPU2. short log: `E CudaDriver XID=79, killing context`
infra-sre: also seeing a huge KV cache eviction spike from the serving runtime right before the hangs — eviction rate jumped 12x. Could be convoying requests into collective paths.
maya: can we reduce concurrency for this model while we triage? set a temporary per-key queue.
oncall-eng: applied API-side concurrency cap for model=gpt-embed-v2: 4 reqs/s per project. should see immediate drop in tail.
ops-lead: I'm going to cordon gpu-node-45 and reschedule pods to limit cross-node collectives. will do a graceful drain.
ops-lead: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-45 && kubectl drain gpu-node-45 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=30`
tj: initiating NVLink health check now. nvlink counters show CRC errors on link 1/2. moving pod on gpu-node-45 -> gpu-node-47.
customer-success: Acme reports elevated latency for realtime-embed endpoint starting ~11:02 UTC, no 5xx yet but spikes in p95/p99. Keeping them informed.
maya: capturing a minidump and nccl debug logs. please save `NCCL_DEBUG=INFO` logs and `dmesg` output.
--- log snippet ---
NCCL WARN Call to Allreduce timed out after 120s
NCCL INFO Rendezvous waiting: group_size=8, alive=6
E CudaDriver: Xid 79, pid=4212, context lost
--- end ---
infra-sre: that pattern matches 'kvcache eviction storm -> increased sequence lengths -> heavy cross-GPU allreduce pressure -> one link degrades -> collective stalls' we've seen this before. Suggest temporary fallback to single-GPU sharding for this tenant.
oncall-eng: fallback route enabled: model=gpt-embed-v2 -> variant=gpt-embed-v2-single-shard in eu-west-1 for tenant=acme-corp.
maya: I'm handing this to SRE for deeper hw validation and NVLink replacement scheduling. I'll keep ownership of the customer comms and postmortem.
ops-lead: marking node gpu-node-45 as maintenance and opening ticket to hardware team (hw-ticket-8921).
customer-success: Notified Acme: "We detect degraded collective performance on multi-gpu path; routing you to single-shard fallback. We'll follow up with a timeline."
infra-sre: collecting perf traces: `nvprof --profile-from-start off --metrics all` and kernel logs. saving to /var/log/incident/1754329000/.
maya: creating incident page draft and setting status -> partial degradation for embeddings in eu-west-1.
incident-bot: Incident note updated: severity=sev2, status=mitigating, assignees=[maya, infra-sre, ops-lead].
ops-lead: after reschedule, observed no further NCCL timeouts on the new pod placements. p95 latency down ~30%.
maya: handing off to infra-sre for root-cause (KV cache behavior + NVLink error chain). Will update postmortem owner and timeline tomorrow.
oncall-eng: closing immediate pager; leaving a follow-up oncall watch for 2 hours.
customer-success: Acme confirmed improved latency with fallback; asked for RCA and ETA on multi-gpu fix.
maya: noted. I'll coordinate RCA and replacement plan.
incident-bot: Pager closed by maya at 1754329325.
